Vulgar Fraction One Third Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for Vulgar Fraction One Third because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+2153, which you can use as ⅓ in HTML, \2153 in CSS, or type with Alt+8531 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. Vulgar Fraction One Third is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+2153 is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. Vulgar Fraction One Third has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ⅓ or the hex escape ⅓.

How to type vulgar fraction one third on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 8 5 3 1 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 8531.
  4. Release Alt. The Vulgar Fraction One Third character (⅓) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type vulgar fraction one third on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Vulgar Fraction One Third. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Vulgar Fraction One Third" and click the character to insert it.

How to use vulgar fraction one third in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\2153"; ()
  • Python: \u2153 or chr(0x2153)
  • JavaScript: \u2153 or String.fromCodePoint(0x2153)
  • JSON: "\u2153"
  • LaTeX: $\frac{1}{3}$ (math mode)

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for ⅓?

No legacy Alt code exists for Vulgar Fraction One Third because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+2153 in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type ⅓ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ⅓, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+8531 not work?

Alt+8531 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Vulgar Fraction One Third?

The Unicode codepoint for Vulgar Fraction One Third is U+2153. You can use this value in HTML as ⅓, in CSS as \2153, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ⅓ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+2153, then click it.
